findings: All 54 original repositories returned HTTP 404 through both their stored GitHub name and repository ID. This does not distinguish deleted repositories from inaccessible private repositories.
The original source importer tried upstream and pm-pl basename candidates only; exact commits for 26 plugins survive in other public forks.
A current inventory of 1185 public pm-pl repositories still yielded only the two previously tried basename candidates, which lack the recorded build commits.

GitHub name searches, additional searches without the PHP language filter, selected alias searches, and exact-commit API checks found 73 matching source commits. Global SHA searches returned zero matches for the other 42 commits; this is not proof that no other copy exists.
Poggit resource URLs now redirect to https://github.com/poggit/release-archive. The inspected plugin directories contain PHARs and release metadata, not complete source-repository ZIPs.

BetterVoting 1.0.0, 1.0.1 and 1.0.2 declare a custom license, have no source license file, and have empty LICENSE.txt files in the official Poggit release archive. ChatToDiscord 1.1.1 declares no license and has no source license file. These four exact ZIPs remain local for review.
recovery_method: Download an unchanged GitHub source ZIP from a public backup at the exact recorded build commit; verify GitHub commit SHA/tree, ZIP commit root, ZIP CRC, local SHA-256 and byte size, then verify the uploaded GitHub release asset independently.

alternative_for_unresolved_plugins.method: Recover distribution source files from original archived PHARs

verified_example.note: Read-only PHAR inspection; plugin code and stub were not executed. Distribution contents do not establish a full Git source snapshot.

alternative_for_unresolved_plugins.limitation: PHAR contents may omit repository files, build configuration and original dependencies, or include build-time transformations. Label any resulting ZIP as recovered from PHAR; do not treat it as a full source snapshot at the Git commit.

publication.website_deployment: The GitHub Pages workflow deploys this catalog when changes are pushed to main.
